objective: Design the feature-opener page for Trevor Paglen's Data Issue piece in the layout bones of the reference 1990s magazine section opener: dominant full-width photograph, huge yellow condensed display headline over a dark image, section slug at top, byline line under the headline.
reference_role: Reference image 1 is the layout authority: photo-to-headline proportion, yellow display type over dark photo, slug placement, dek column position. None of its words or images may appear. Reference image 2 supplies the sole photograph: a coastal landing-site image that becomes the full-width feature photo.
preservation_invariants: Keep the donor's structure: section slug top-left, full-width dark photograph bleeding to three edges, display headline knocked out in warm yellow across the photo's lower third, short dek column below.
Keep the ominous documentary mood: the photograph reads as evidence, not decoration.
canvas: Photograph occupies roughly the upper two thirds; the lower third carries the dek column and greeked body text opening.

regions.name: section slug
regions.change: Top-left reads 'DATA' in the donor's compact bold caps with a thin rule.

regions.name: display headline
regions.change: Across the photo's lower area: 'NSA-TAPPED CABLE LANDING SITE' in large warm-yellow condensed caps, broken over two lines.
preserve: Donor's knockout treatment and scale relative to the page.

regions.name: byline and dek
regions.change: Under the headline: 'BY TREVOR PAGLEN' in small caps, then a two-line dek in italic reading 'Mastic Beach, New York: where the ocean hands the internet to the shore, and someone is listening.'

regions.name: body opening
regions.change: One or two columns of greeked, unreadable period body type with a large drop cap letter M.

exact_copy.text: Mastic Beach, New York: where the ocean hands the internet to the shore, and someone is listening.

style: Mid-1990s American music-magazine interior: heavy condensed and outlined display type, aggressive section headers, layered photo collage energy, warm coated-paper white, CMYK halftone grain.
Typography classification only: condensed grotesque display, outlined slab accents, small dense sans body columns; no digital-era fonts.
asset_rules: Use the photograph from reference image 2 exactly once as the page's primary art; crop is allowed, distortion and mirroring are not.
Ignore the flat gray matte surrounding the photograph in reference image 2; it is packing material, not content.
negative_constraints: No legible paragraph-length body text anywhere: running text must be greeked, soft-blurred print texture that is clearly type but unreadable at full size.
Do not reproduce the donor page's own photographs, advertisements, products, celebrities, phone numbers, or brand marks; the donor supplies layout bones and typographic idiom only.
No New York Magazine masthead, no VIBE masthead, no Newport/Absolut/Levi's or any real advertisement, no barcode with real digits, no real cover price.
No watermark, no border artifacts from the reference matte, no gray letterbox bars carried into the composition.
No misspelled masthead, no duplicated headline, no extra unrelated cover lines, no modern flat-UI aesthetic, no smartphone-era design elements.
The photograph must stay recognizably the supplied coastal scene; do not replace it with a generic beach.
quality_checks: At thumbnail size the page reads as an authentic mid-1990s printed magazine page: coated-paper tone, slight halftone grain, period type rendering.
Every exact-copy string is legible, spelled exactly as specified, and appears exactly once.
The transplanted DIS photograph is clearly recognizable and undistorted, integrated with period-correct print reproduction.
